pricing.billingNote: Public university special collection; select digital collections free online.
pricing.freeTierNote: ~6,500 digitized recordings streamable via UMKC Digital Commons; 350,000+ physical items on campus.

provenance.primaryMasterSource: Physical home of the J. David Goldin 16" ET Collection, CBS/KMOX discs, and Raymond R. Wile Collection
provenance.airdateMethodology: Archival finding aids & physical 16" disc label metadata
provenance.castAttributionMethod: Library Dublin Core / MARC metadata from Goldin discography

specNotes.free_no_paywall: Only ~1,250 of 18,000 holdings stream online; remainder requires Kansas City reading-room visit.

primary_source_verification.summary: Cataloged directly from physical 16" transcription disc labels and institutional finding aids.
primary_source_verification.evidenceQuote: "Metadata derived directly from the physical 16-inch electrical transcriptions in the Goldin and KMOX collections."

cast_credit_accuracy.summary: Incorporates Goldin's detailed performer and production credits in archival finding aids.
cast_credit_accuracy.evidenceQuote: "Finding aids preserve complete performer, announcer, and sponsor credits from the Goldin database."

vtt_transcripts.summary: No synchronized WebVTT transcripts for dramatic/variety radio broadcasts.
vtt_transcripts.evidenceQuote: "Digital Commons audio embeds do not include WebVTT timed caption files."

master_provenance.summary: Direct stylus-to-ADC transfers from original 16" lacquer and vinyl pressings by professional audio engineers.
master_provenance.evidenceQuote: "Digitized in-house from original 16-inch transcription discs using custom archival turntables and stylus profiles."

serial_continuity.summary: Finding aids list episodes sequentially, but online digital exhibits feature curated highlights rather than full serial runs.
serial_continuity.evidenceQuote: "Online Digital Commons portal hosts selected highlights rather than complete contiguous series runs."

open_api_export.summary: OAI-PMH library harvesting supported for metadata, but no public audio streaming API.
open_api_export.evidenceQuote: "Supports institutional OAI-PMH metadata harvesting via UMKC Digital Commons."

ad_free_playback.summary: Free and ad-free for the ~6,500 items online; remaining ~88,500 items require Kansas City reading-room access.
ad_free_playback.evidenceQuote: "On-site research access at Miller Nichols Library required for non-digitized or rights-restricted discs."

dedup_integrity.summary: Accession and disc matrix numbers uniquely identify every physical transcription disc.
dedup_integrity.evidenceQuote: "Unique institutional accession numbers mapped to physical disc shelves."

gotchas.title: 93% of Holdings Require On-Site Kansas City Research Visit
gotchas.detail: While UMKC holds the physical 16" discs behind RadioGOLDINdex, copyright policy restricts online streaming to a small subset of digitized exhibits.
